meta.name: geomaster
meta.description: Comprehensive geospatial science skill covering remote sensing, GIS, spatial analysis, machine learning for earth observation, and 30+ scientific domains. Supports satellite imagery processing (Sentinel, Landsat, MODIS, SAR, hyperspectral), vector and raster data operations, spatial statistics, point cloud processing, network analysis, cloud-native workflows (STAC, COG, Planetary Computer), and 8 programming languages (Python, R, Julia, JavaScript, C++, Java, Go, Rust) with 500+ code examples. Use for remote sensing workflows, GIS analysis, spatial ML, Earth observation data processing, terrain analysis, hydrological modeling, marine spatial analysis, atmospheric science, and any geospatial computation task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析卫星影像与地理空间数据,构建空间机器学习模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常处理卫星影像和地理空间数据,需要多语言示例
copy.tagline_en: Process satellite imagery and geospatial data, and build spatial machine learning models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with remote sensing and GIS data and need code examples in multiple languages

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 GeoMaster 的代码示例回答地理空间问题,例如用 Rasterio 算 NDVI、用 GeoPandas 做空间连接、用 STAC 检索影像,并给出安装命令与性能建议。
howto.when: 当任务涉及遥感、GIS 分析、空间机器学习等地理空间计算时触发。

say.text: 用 Sentinel-2 影像计算 NDVI,并保存为 GeoTIFF。
say.note: Claude 会写出 NDVI 计算脚本。

say.text: 对两个 GeoJSON 做空间连接,统计各区域的均值。
say.note: Claude 会用 GeoPandas 生成分析代码。

say.text: 从 S3 的 COG 影像中裁剪一块窗口并读取。
say.note: Claude 会演示 COG 部分读取方法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use GeoMaster's code examples to answer geospatial questions, e.g., computing NDVI with Rasterio, spatial joins with GeoPandas, and searching imagery with STAC; it also gives installation commands and performance tips.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task involves geospatial computation such as remote sensing, GIS analysis, spatial ML, etc.

say_en.text: Calculate NDVI from Sentinel-2 imagery and save as GeoTIFF.
say_en.note: Claude will write an NDVI calculation script.

say_en.text: Spatially join two GeoJSON files and compute the mean per zone.
say_en.note: Claude will generate GeoPandas analysis code.

say_en.text: Crop and read a window from a COG image on S3.
say_en.note: Claude will demonstrate partial COG reading.
